name: gslide-mcp
description: Typed tools for building Google Slides decks from Claude: layouts, themed components, charts, tables, notes, comments.
long_description:
Build, edit and screenshot Google Slides presentations from Claude Desktop: create decks from templates, fill placeholders, insert images and charts, copy slides across decks, and render slide ranges to PNG for visual QA.

First run requires a Google OAuth Desktop-app client (credentials.json) — see the OAuth setup guide linked below.

cred_dir.title: Credentials directory
cred_dir.description: Folder holding your Google OAuth credentials.json; token.json is written here after first sign-in.

appscript_url.title: Apps Script web-app URL (optional)
appscript_url.description: Deployed web-app URL for cross-deck slide copy. Leave empty unless you followed docs/appscript-setup.md.

logodev_token.title: logo.dev token (optional)
logodev_token.description: Enables logo.dev as an extra source for company logos in the assets tools.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Default theme for components (periscope, default, or a theme in ~/.gslides-mcp/themes).

assets_folder.title: Assets folder (Drive)
assets_folder.description: Id or URL of the shared Drive folder holding pictos and logos (PNG) used by components.
